result.stdout:
SageFs - F# Interactive daemon with MCP, hot reloading, and live dashboard

Usage: SageFs [options]                Start daemon (default mode)
       SageFs check                    Check environment before first run
       SageFs --supervised [options]   Start with watchdog auto-restart
       SageFs --jupyter <conn.json>    Run as Jupyter kernel
       SageFs mcp                      Speak MCP over stdio (spawns the daemon if needed)
       SageFs stop                     Stop running daemon
       SageFs status                   Show daemon info
       SageFs sweep [--kill]           Reap daemons whose owner process is gone
       SageFs play <ledger.jsonl>      Replay a portable cohort ledger file offline

Options:
  --version, -v          Show version information
  --help, -h             Show this help message
  --mcp-port PORT        Set custom MCP server port (default: 37749)
  --jupyter FILE         Run as Jupyter kernel with given connection file
  --supervised           Run under watchdog supervisor (auto-restart on crash)
  --no-resume            Skip restoring previous sessions on daemon startup
  --prune                Mark all stale sessions as stopped and exit
  --owner-pid PID        Exit when the process at PID exits (fenced by --owner-start
                         when given). For daemons an agent, test, or demo spawns.
  --owner-start TICKS    UTC ticks of the owner's own start time, pairs with
                         --owner-pid to close the pid-reuse race.
  --ttl DURATION         Self-terminate after DURATION (e.g. 30m, 1h, 90s) with no
                         live sessions and no MCP/SSE clients.

  A small number of legacy or not-yet-wired flags are still recognized but
  are refused with an explanation instead of being silently accepted — pass
  one and read the error for what to do instead.

Exit codes:
  sagefs check   0 = every check passed          1 = at least one check failed
  sagefs stop    0 = a running daemon was stopped 1 = there was nothing 
[truncated]
